photos.desc: We spotted these American white pelicans at Shiawassee National Wildlife Refuge in Michigan. Photo by Jim Hudgins/USFWS.

Pelican Facts Pelican is an amazing bird that can be found on all continents except on the Antarctica. There are eight species of pelicans. These birds are usually located in warm regions, near rivers
